title: Digital Teammates for Content Creators
cardDesc: Malleable software platform where AI writes new tools at runtime. Merge any skills together and the agent generates working code on the fly.

sections.title: Malleable Software
items: Software that writes itself: merge any skills together and AI generates working code at runtime
No predefined integrations. The Merge Agent reads source skills, designs a unified workflow, and writes new Python scripts
True composability: every tool becomes a building block for tools that don't exist yet

sections.title: How It Works
items: Drag 2-3 skills into a group (e.g., Comment Analysis + Quote Card Generator)
Claude Opus reads the source code, reasons about how to combine them, and writes a new merged skill
The new skill is tested end-to-end, saved to database, and ready to use. All without human coding

sections.title: Built-in Skills
items: YouTube Comment Report: Fetch, categorize, and email themed reports
Competitive Report: Compare channels with video summaries via Gemini
Video Clipper: Transcribe and create vertical clips with face tracking
Instagram Card Generator: AI-generated quote cards from any text

sections.title: Technical Architecture
items: Merge Agent (Claude Opus) writes new skills by composing existing ones. Real code generation at runtime
Three-agent system: Main (executes), Merge (creates skills), Debug (auto-fixes broken skills)
Self-healing: if a merged skill fails, Debug Agent diagnoses and patches the code automatically
